Rev. Lawrence G. Lovasik, a Divine Word missionary priest, wrote this devotional booklet on the seven sacraments of the Catholic Church. The Catholic Book Publishing Company of New York issued it in the plain, warm style that made Lovasik's prayer books household items.

Baptism, confirmation, Communion, and the rest of the seven are each explained in short, simple sections meant for readers of all ages. Lovasik tells what each sacrament is, where it comes from in scripture and tradition, and how a believer takes part in it. Generations of Catholic families learned their faith from booklets like this one.
